text: Beeswax. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. You're my new bee scout.
Look around. When something matters to bees, you'll hear about it.
Bee fact found!

label: beehive
text: A hive. Union headquarters. Want the gossip?

label: beehive
text: One queen lays the colony's eggs. The workers are all girls. Drones like me can't even sting.

label: native_flower
text: Flowers. That's the cafeteria. Want the menu?

label: native_flower
text: Plant native flowers that bloom spring to fall, so the cafeteria never closes. A balcony pot counts.

label: honey_jar
text: Store honey. Looks harmless. Want to know why it isn't?

label: honey_jar
text: Never feed it to bees. It can carry foulbrood, and its spores last decades. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.

label: pebble_dish
text: Water with pebbles. Somebody gets it. Want to know why?

label: pebble_dish
text: Bees can't swim, so pebbles give us a landing spot. Back home we fan the drops. Bee air conditioning.

label: bug_spray
text: Bug spray. I'm filing a grievance. Want to hear it?

label: bug_spray
text: Spray drifts onto flowers, and we carry it home to the babies. Skip it, especially on anything in bloom.

label: bee_hotel
text: Housing for my wild cousins. Want the tour?

label: bee_hotel
text: Seven in ten wild bees nest underground. Leave a patch of bare dirt and they'll move right in.
Fine. Filed for later.
Your loss. Moving on.
Rude. That's going in the minutes.
I'll take that as a no.
Look around. Something here matters to bees.
One down. Five to go.
Two. Keep looking.
Three down. Three to go.
Four. You're making me look good.
Five. Don't slow down now.
Six for six. You're hired. New contract: plant flowers, skip the bug spray, put out a pebble dish.
